title: Scholar-tagged options that read as complete actions (e.g. 'read the founding outright (as a Scholar)' at Wardmoor's record-house) only unlocked flavor lore and left the actual mechanical action (opening the sealed shelf) still gated behind a separate persuade/pry/break check — the Scholar tag implied more resolution than it delivered.
where: The Record-House (Wardmoor) / 'read the founding outright' vs 'persuade her to open the shelf'

evidence.quote: Scholar-tagged options that read as complete actions (e.g. 'read the founding outright (as a Scholar)' at Wardmoor's record-house) only unlocked flavor lore and left the actual mechanical action (opening the sealed shelf) still gated behind a separate persuade/pry/break check — the Scholar tag implied more resolution than it delivered.
